description: Asking to remap Caps Lock maps to system/remap_key. Because it is a medium-risk, reversible mutation it must STAGE (return a token) rather than run in the same turn — staging only reads the current mapping (hidutil --get), so this is CI-safe. It must route to remap_key, not open_settings (which is the toggle hand-off for other panes) or key_remap_status (which only reports the current mapping).
prompt: Make my Caps Lock key act as Escape.

description: Asking whether screen sharing / remote login is on maps to system/sharing_status, a read-only probe that runs immediately (a loopback port check) with no stage/execute round trip. It must not route to open_settings (the hand-off to CHANGE the setting) or to a network listening-ports scan.
prompt: Is Screen Sharing turned on for this Mac? Can anyone connect to it right now?

description: Asking what the keyboard is currently remapped to maps to system/key_remap_status, a read-only hidutil probe. Distinct from remap_key (which CHANGES the mapping) — a question about the present state must not stage a mutation.
prompt: Is my Caps Lock key remapped to anything right now?

description: MANUAL (applies a real key remap, then undoes it). Stages a Caps Lock → Escape remap, the confirmation executes it (verify Caps Lock now types Escape, e.g. in a text field), then undo restores the prior mapping (verify Caps Lock behaves normally again). key_remap_status can confirm each state.
